label: Modal spine A2: inert emptiness from two grounding principles, objection and warrant audit
summary: Target: premise A2 of Arrival A in the modal spine (inert emptiness, 395cb0f6, InertEmptiness.EmptinessStaysEmpty), consumed by InertEmptiness.necessaryConcrete toward STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT and STMT-GOD-EXISTS. Spec specs/modal-spine-grounded-beginnings.toml, module TruthCore/Causality/GroundedBeginnings.lean. Repaired after the independent semantic challenge of PR #1478 (accept with repairs). DERIVATION. Two OPEN analyst premises over a supplied world-relative grounding relation (same shape as BruteFoundationBoundary.Profile.grounds; intended sense: the proximate ground of a thing's coming to be, per se or per accidens, DISAMB-CAUSAL-SERIES; concrete is A2's supplied predicate, DISAMB-CONCRETE-ABSTRACT-CRITERIA). A2ab lasting ground (71df1177): a concrete thing absent at s and present at a later moment has SOME concrete ground present at s or later. A2c post-absence well-founded grounding (bf18a0d0): for every history and moment s, grounding among concrete things absent at s and present later is well-founded. (1) nothingFromNothing (result a0b4130d): A2ab and A2c give the traced form of 'from nothing, nothing comes' (e6a1ac3c); well-founded induction, non-transcription. (2) inertOfNothingFromNothing (c758bec1): the traced form gives A2; registered strengthens relation, strict by control 5. (3) inertOfGroundedBeginnings (2da7db60): A2ab and A2c give A2, the support route the frontier counts. (4) postAbsenceOfPresent (a788d424): the earlier, stronger well-foundedness premise (81c39a34, grounding among all present concreta) gives A2c; registered strengthens relation, strict by control 7. (5) controls (d3d432c9): each premise is needed (control 1: ground-free beginning; control 2: every beginning has a concrete ground but the only ground ceased before an empty moment; control 3: BegunComingToBe.Control.zeno, A2ab holds and A2c fails); no modal content (control 4, initialState); strictness of the traced form (control 5); joint nonvacuity with the route (control 6, rooted); and control 7 (integer times, n present from n on, grounded by n - 1): A2ab, A2c and A2 hold while the strong well-foundedness premise fails. REPAIRS FROM THE CHALLENGE. (a) The first version used a strong premise (well-founded grounding among all present concreta). It is stronger than needed and is contested by a sourced claim: Aquinas grants that an infinite per accidens series of causes (successive generations) is not impossible (ST I q.46 a.2 ad 7, STMT-INFINITE-REGRESS-IMPOSSIBLE-ONLY-IN-PER-SE-SERIES, claim AQUINAS-ST-I-Q46-A2-AD7-PER-SE-REGRESS-A). That claim names the target, a mechanism (an endless past of generations) and a source, so it is a substantive objection to the strong version. Control 7 confirms that such a past satisfies A2 and A2ab. The derivation now uses only A2c, which that past satisfies; whether Aquinas's grant extends to an endless series compressed after a moment at which all its members are absent (the zeno shape) is an unread, open bridge. (b) The first version also had a universal premise that NO ground of a beginning had ceased before the absence. Ordinary remote grounds violate it: a grandparent who died in 1950 is a remote ground of a grandchild born in 2000, with s = 1980; posthumous conception is another example. That is a substantive objection. A2ab now asks only that SOME ground be present at s or later. (c) The ground relation's sense is now stated in definitions 1f4f5228 and 9c097ca8 and the module docstring, and DISAMB-CAUSAL-SERIES and DISAMB-CONCRETE-ABSTRACT-CRITERIA are linked from every new statement and argument; the shared DISAMB-CAUSAL-SERIES resolution is not edited, because a bundle audit pins it. (d) The A2ab paraphrase no longer says the ground is 'in that history': presence comes from the clause, existence only from A1. CIRCULARITY CHECK. A2ab and A2c carry no modal content: they hold in a model with no necessary concrete individual at any world (control 4), unlike the founded-past grounding bundle (ComingToBeHorns.possiblyNecessaryOfEarlierGrounds). In Arrival A, necessity arises from A2 jointly with A3, presence-to-existence and the frame premises; none of these suffices without A2 (InertEmptiness.Control.exNihilo). OBJECTION AUDIT (Substantive Objection Standard). (i) The recorded rival, a beginning out of nothing (84526937), is model-witnessed only (InertEmptiness.Control.exNihilo); no independent justification for its mechanism is on file, so it is not a substantive objection. (ii) Hartle and Hawking (claim e6300451, read, pp. 2960-2961): a ground-state wave function from a sum over compact Euclidean four-geometries. As recorded, the claim contains no time-ordered pair of a concrete-empty moment and a later populated one; the proposal supplies a quantum state and an action. Analyst gloss: its Euclidean regime has no Lorentzian time in which a zero three-geometry would precede the universe. So it bears on the initial-state question (A3), not on A2. Vilenkin 1982 is an UNREAD lead and is given no weight. (iii) Quantum vacuum (UNREAD lead): under the adopted esse-in-re sense of concrete (CONCRETE_6, DISAMB-CONCRETE-ABSTRACT-CRITERIA), whether a vacuum field state is a concrete individual is OPEN. If it is, the moment is not concrete-empty and A2 is untouched. If it is not, a vacuum moment followed by particles would bear on A2 only with an independent account of such a moment; none is on file. (iv) FLRW: the initial singularity is not a point of the spacetime manifold, so there is no empty moment and A2 is silent. Adjoining t = 0 as an empty moment would make a populated FLRW history an instance of A2's rival, so it would violate A2ab or A2c under any grounding interpretation. Which one fails depends on the supplied individuals, presence and grounding relation, and is UNTESTED for FLRW. GroundedBeginnings.controls classifies only the integer-indexed zeno interpretation with predecessor grounds (A2ab holds, A2c fails); with no grounds, A2ab fails instead (control 1). No justification for adjoining t = 0 is on file. RESULT. No rebutting objection to A2, A2ab or A2c is identified. Standing objections: the per accidens infinite-series claim of Aquinas (sourced) against the strong well-foundedness premise, which is no longer used; the remote-ground objection against the former universal ceased-ground premise, which is replaced; and one undercutting objection, by parity from the contingent-natural restriction rival recorded for B2 (attempt 169b007b, docs/notes/causal-temporal-rival-coverage.md), against an INDUCTIVE warrant for A2ab and A2. The inductive base of ordinary caused beginnings always contains an available bearer, so it supports equally well 'beginnings within a populated history have grounds present then or later', and that restricted principle is silent exactly when the earlier moment is empty, which is where A2 is needed. The undercutting objection is not evidence of an ungrounded beginning; a non-inductive ex nihilo warrant would not face it, but none is on file. Standing rival of A2c: an endless series of grounds compressed after an empty moment (zeno shape); no independent justification for it is on file beyond the open extension of Aquinas's grant. WARRANT AUDIT. Before this attempt no independent warrant for A2 was on file. Now A2 has a derivation from two OPEN premises, neither sourced nor established. The derivation relocates A2's warrant into these premises; it does not show that they are better warranted than A2. The crux of Arrival A remains the universal scope of A2 (equivalently of A2ab with A2c) over every possible history, including one with an empty moment. No premise is established.
blocker: Not blocked. A2ab and A2c are OPEN with no source or independent warrant on file. The standing objection to A2ab and A2 is an undercutting objection to inductive warrant; the standing rival of A2c is the compressed endless series. Next tests: state and test a non-inductive ex nihilo warrant for A2ab; read ST I q.46 a.2 ad 7 in context to test whether Aquinas's grant of infinite per accidens series extends to a series compressed after one moment; read Vilenkin 1982 if the quantum-cosmological lead is selected; check the simultaneous-regress shape of the A2c rival (an endless regress of grounds all present at one later moment) with a model; specify a grounding interpretation for an FLRW history with an adjoined empty moment if that case is selected; compare A2c with a condition on time (founded intervals above the empty moment).
